remarks: Modern meets elegance at 83 Red Coat Road in Westport. Proposed, custom new construction by award winning Coastal Luxury Homes, come meet with Joe Feinleib and MarcSells.Homes to walk the property and design your dream house.  This Modern Colonial will be built with the highest craftsmanship and most modern building techniques available today. You will sit high above the stunning Saugatuck River on almost 3 acres of professionally landscaped and mature foliage in this 6,400 square foot home. FOUR HUNRED FEET of crystal-clear rolling river frontage will be your views and sound from almost every room.
